selected_workloads.name: topology
selected_workloads.scope: local workflow/source validators and synthetic fixtures; no network or publisher

arms.fresh: six public ExecuteWithStreams calls, one task per short-lived child
arms.resident: one bounded ExecuteWithStreams call serving the same six JSONL tasks

driver.positional_arguments: mode INPUT_ROOT TASK_ROOT LEASE_DIR ARTIFACT START_SEQUENCE; integer 1..6; control mode requires 1
driver.sequence_policy: worker starts at START_SEQUENCE, then requires strictly increasing exact sequence through 6 and validates alternating workload parity; control starts at 1

alternate_task.reason_not_selected: host Python 3.12.14 has PyYAML 6.0.3 but _sqlite3 has no __file__; task dereferences __file__. Repository conda spec pins Python 3.11/PyYAML 6.0.2; matching materialized dependency availability not established read-only.

controls: cancel after same-process-group child readiness; outer process-group cleanup and lease absence required
limitations: trusted cooperative process-state isolation, not OS security sandbox
no test execution or native benchmark in this lane
